about: Model verdicts on source against tree for adg (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: The bold opening words of a sentence are read as a heading, so the sentence is split between a heading and its text.
findings.evidence: source: "Gas Safety (Installation and Use) Regulations (SI 1998/2451) extend to all dangers" / tree: heading "Gas Safety (Installation and Use) Regulations", text "(SI 1998/2451) extend to all dangers"

findings.problem: The closing paragraph after the list is merged into list item e.
findings.evidence: source: "the water efficiency of the building." then new paragraph "Where a building consists of more than one dwelling" / tree: "e. ... efficiency of the building. Where a building consists of more than one dwelling"

findings.problem: Words with fi and fl ligatures lost letters.
findings.evidence: source: "fittings", "sufficient", "block of flats", "reflected" / tree: "fttings", "suffcient", "block of fats", "refected"

findings.problem: Words with fi ligatures lost letters, including the word five in a time limit.
findings.evidence: source: "no later than five days", "fittings", "Notification", "specified", "final certificate" / tree: "no later than fve days", "fttings", "Notifcation", "specifed", "fnal certifcate"

findings.problem: Words with fi and fl ligatures lost letters.
findings.evidence: source: "fittings approach", "self-certification", "reflect" / tree: "fttings approach", "self-certifcation", "refect"

findings.problem: The two columns of the worked example are mixed line by line, so the second calculation and its conclusion come before and inside the first one.
findings.evidence: tree: "Therefore the maximum permitted length equates to 5.8m which, is less than the actual length of 7m therefore calculate The example below is for a G½"

findings.problem: The last words of the worked example are split off and placed as a text block under the 'Notes:' heading after note 2.
findings.evidence: source: "As the actual length is 7m, a 28mm (D2) copper pipe will be satisfactory." / tree (under Notes:): "be satisfactory."

findings.problem: Paragraphs 3.59 and 3.60 are placed under the 'Worked example:' heading, though they are ordinary guidance under 'Discharge pipe D2'.
findings.evidence: tree: "Guidance > Discharge pipes from safety devices > Worked example: > Paragraph 3.59"

findings.problem: In the table text the footnote line sits between the G1 rows instead of after the table.
findings.evidence: tree: "G1 28mm 35mm Up to 9m 1.4m", "*see 3.51 and 3.58 and Diagram 1", "42mm Up to 18m 1.7m"

findings.problem: The grids have an invented first column with row labels that are not printed.

findings.evidence: tree: "...the water efficiency calculator must be completed.” © Crown copyright, 2016 You may re-use this information (excluding logos) free of charge"

findings.problem: Two separate headings are joined into one chapter title.

findings.problem: The page number is kept at the end of the body text.
findings.evidence: tree: "for copies purchased after ??? 2015. 12"

findings.evidence: source: "Which version of the Approved Document applies to my project? 12" (contents line) / tree: heading with text "4 Revised Part G of Schedule 1 to the Building Regulations 2000"

findings.problem: The page number is read into the body text.

findings.evidence: source: "than 48°C. It’s likely that this will normally be complied with by the fitting of a thermostatic mixing valve (TMV)."

findings.problem: Each question heading is split line by line into several separate headings, so each answer sits under only the last fragment of its question.
findings.evidence: source: "Do these requirements apply to small water heaters such as water heaters of less than 15 litres that were previously exempt?" / tree: heading "exempt?"

findings.problem: The page number is read as body text under a fragment of the last question heading.
findings.evidence: tree: heading "pipe should be either polybutalene or cross linked" with text "8"

findings.problem: Two separate paragraphs that follow the lettered lists are joined onto the last list item before them, so they read as part of items b and c.
findings.evidence: source: "Please note that ‘building notice’..." and "Full details of the changes are provided below." as own paragraphs / tree: "b. ... beginning on that day. Please note that", "c. ... has stated. Full details of the changes"

findings.problem: The bold reference "BS 6465-2." that ends paragraphs 4.12, 4.19 and 5.7 was read as a heading three times, so each paragraph is cut short and the text after it hangs under a false heading.
findings.evidence: source: "4.12 Guidance on the provision of activity space around sanitary appliances is given in BS 6465-2." / tree: paragraph text "...is given in" then heading "BS 6465-2."

findings.evidence: source: "Replace paragraph 4.15 with the following." (own line before 4.16) / tree: "...to meet requirement T1. Replace paragraph 4.15 with the following." inside paragraph 4.15

findings.problem: The note that belongs to paragraph 5.7 is split from it and kept as a separate text block under the false heading "BS 6465-2.".
findings.evidence: source: "Note: Refer to Appendix D of Approved Document T for guidance on minimum depth and width dimensions" under 5.7 / tree: separate text under "BS 6465-2. > Text"

findings.problem: The heading "Scale of provision and layout in buildings other than dwellings" and the paragraphs after it are not under the G4 heading that paragraphs 4.5 to 4.7 sit under.
findings.evidence: tree: "List of amendments May 2024 > Scale of provision and layout in buildings other than dwellings"
